_comment: Spend limits per Ramp Router account (src/budget.ts). limitUsd = what this benchmark may spend from now on, counted in runs/ledger.jsonl; set below the account's remaining credit (2026-10-14 evening: A $25.49, B $14.72) to absorb estimate error and, on B, the user's other apps (~$0.37/day). Paid batches refuse to start while confirmed is false.
_confirmed: Key-to-account mapping confirmed 2026-10-14 by spending a few cents on each key and reading back each account's per-key spend.
_marginUsd: Reserved per in-flight run: a worst-case single run (an impossible task looping to max steps on Sonnet). With concurrency N, N × margin is held back.

prices._comment: USD per million tokens, used only when a run has no Router-reported cost. All UNVERIFIED and set on the high side so the budget stop errs early.
